name: Spatial Analysis / Geostatistics
when_to_use: Data with geographic location (coordinates, municipality, region); account for the fact that nearby observations tend to be more alike (spatial autocorrelation) instead of treating each point as independent.

expected_input.question: How does the geographic location of each observation relate to the measured value?

plain_explanation.purpose: Analyzes data that has a place on the map, checking whether neighbors resemble each other.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When location matters for the outcome.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Values per location, with coordinates or a region identifier.
plain_explanation.example: See whether neighborhoods with a high incidence of a problem cluster together.
